edu.acg.itss

Class DesiredCourses

  • java.lang.Object
    • edu.acg.itss.DesiredCourses

  • public class DesiredCourses
extends java.lang.Object
    maintains the courses the student has declared they want to take. It also maintains courses the student doesn't want to take, and also possibly when the student wants to take a course.

    • Method Detail

      • readDesiredCoursesFromFile

        public void readDesiredCoursesFromFile(java.lang.String filename)
        reads desired courses from file, if it exists. The file consists of lines that follow the format: <coursecode>;[term ]* The string "allterms" is allowed as "term" value.
        Parameters:
        filename - String

      • addCourse

        public void addCourse(java.lang.String code)
        add the argument to the desired courses.
        Parameters:
        code - String

      • addCourse

        public void addCourse(java.lang.String code,
                      java.util.Set<java.lang.String> allowed_terms)
        add desired course for given terms. If terms is empty, course is NOT desired!.
        Parameters:
        code - String
        allowed_terms - Set<String> may be empty

      • clear

        public void clear()
        clear the set of courses.

      • addAll

        public void addAll(java.util.Collection<java.lang.String> codes)
        add all course codes in the set.
        Parameters:
        codes - Collection<String> each string may be just a code such as "ITC3160" which means we want the course and don't care when we register for it, or it may be "ITC3160;" which means we do NOT want the course, or it may be "ITC3160;FA2022 SP2023" which means we want to take the course either in FA2023 or in SP2023.

      • contains

        public boolean contains(java.lang.String code)
        check if the course described by code is desired or not.
        Parameters:
        code - String
        Returns:
        boolean true iff code is in the _desiredCourseCodes set.

      • getPreferredTerms4Course

        public java.util.Set<java.lang.Integer> getPreferredTerms4Course(java.lang.String code,
                                                                 int cur_term,
                                                                 int Smax)
        get the preferred terms for the given course in terms of the term numbers from the current date (for example {1, 2, 3}).
        Parameters:
        code - String
        cur_term - int must be in [0, 1, ...Smax] with 0 indicating there is no cur_term to which the course with the given code is assigned
        Smax - int
        Returns:
        Set<Integer>
